mission.title: The Stolen Artifact
mission.description: Carry out assignment with first Redpill you extracted.

phase.briefing:
I come to you with a matter of utmost importance, Warrior. Several groups of Exiles attacked one of our bases last week. The Frenchman denies responsibility, claiming it's the work of renegades who operate outside of his control. You will be working with the crew of the Proditio on this assignment.
Go to this location to meet with the crew of the Proditio. Additional instructions will be sent to you when you reach your first objective ... Oh, one more thing: You might also like to hear that the Captain of the Proditio, Castor, was the first Redpill candidate that you recruited ...

enter.say: Meet up with Captain Castor of the Proditio. Once you've spoken with him, escort him and his crew to the strike location.

objective.text: Lead Castor out of the building
Do not let Captain Castor die

phase.briefing: The purpose of this attack is to determine if what the Merovingian says is true or not. If he is lying, then we will eliminate a few of the Exiles under his control and strike back for the attacks that have been made. If he is telling the truth, we will put a stop to these renegades and hopefully prevent further attacks from being made against Zion bases.

enter.say: You must recover any documentation that will help Zion determine if these Exiles are working for the Merovingian or not. If the Merovingian is at fault, we may have to strike back for his hostility.

objective.text: Search the Exile base for documents
Lead Castor out of the area
Upload the documents through a hardline
Do not let Captain Castor die

phase.briefing:
Before we can recover the artifact for ourselves, we must cause a diversion at another base; otherwise we'll never be able to pry the artifact out of the hands of the renegades.
Eliminate all of the renegade Exiles and you will proceed to the next location to extract the artifact from Exile hands.

enter.say: This is the place. Good luck..

objective.text: Lead Castor out of the area
Do not let Captain Castor die

phase.briefing:
This assault is just what we needed to pull the artifact from the hands of the renegades.
I'm sending you the second set of coordinates which is the artifact's location. We're not concerned about how you complete your objective, but you must recover the artifact.

enter.say: Be on the lookout for an Exile that goes by the calling Ludovica. If you do see her, it would serve our interest and the Merovingian's if she was no longer a factor in the equation.

objective.text: Lead Castor out of the area
Do not let Captain Castor die

phase.briefing: Keep moving, Warrior. You must meet with Lalande. Oh, and don't lose Castor.

enter.say: This is where you can find Lalande.
